```{r}
##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##
## Project: Monthly Airbnb Demand Forecasting - Fortworth
## Instructor: Dr. Jabir Rahman
##----------------------------------------------------------------------------##

library(fpp3)
library(readr)
library(dbplyr)
library(tseries)

# 1. LOAD DATA
path_to_data <- "data/reviews.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv(path_to_data)

# 2. DATA PREPARATION & MONTHLY AGGREGATION
# We aggregate the 'count' from the raw data into monthly buckets
library(lubridate)

# Convert FIRST
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

# Now this works
last_date <- max(raw_data$date, na.rm = TRUE)

last_complete_month <- yearmonth(
  floor_date(last_date, "month") - days(1)
)

airbnb <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date)) %>%
  count(month, name = "count") %>%
  filter(month <= last_complete_month) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = month) %>%
  mutate(log_count = log1p(count))

# 3. EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS (Shortened to post-2022 for stability)
airbnb_short <- airbnb %>% filter(year(month) >2022)
sum(is.na(airbnb_short$count))

# Visualization of Trend and Seasonality
airbnb_short %>% autoplot(log_count) + 
  labs(title = "Monthly Airbnb Log-Demand (Fortworth)", y = "Log(Count)")

# Stationary check (ADF test)
# Part 1 Rubric: Statistical Stationarity Check
# Using nsdiffs and ndiffs as the primary statistical evidence for stationarity
print("--- Statistical Property Check ---")
stats_check <- airbnb_short %>%
  features(log_count, list(unitroot_ndiffs, unitroot_nsdiffs))

knitr::kable(stats_check, caption = "Stationarity Property Check (Required Diffs)")
library(tseries)
log_count_vec <- as.numeric(airbnb_short$log_count)
adf_result <- adf.test(log_count_vec)
print(adf_result)
kpss_result <- kpss.test(log_count_vec, null = "Level")
print(kpss_result)
pp_result <- pp.test(log_count_vec)
print(pp_result)

# STL Decomposition
airbnb_short %>%
  model(stl = STL(log_count)) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot() + labs(title = "STL Decomposition: Trend, Seasonality, and Randomness")

# 4. TRAIN/TEST SPLIT
# Hold out the last 6 months for testing
h_horizon <- 6
train <- airbnb_short %>% slice(1:(n() - h_horizon))
test  <- airbnb_short %>% slice_tail(n = h_horizon)

# 5. BUILD ALL MODELS (Consolidated)
# This includes Baseline, Exponential Smoothing, ARIMA, and others
fit_all <- train %>%
  model(
    # Part 2: Baseline
    Mean = MEAN(log_count),
    `Naïve` = NAIVE(log_count),
    `Seasonal Naïve` = SNAIVE(log_count),
    Drift = RW(log_count ~ drift()),
    ETS = ETS(log_count),
    Auto_ARIMA = ARIMA(log_count),
    Manual_SARIMA = ARIMA(log_count ~ pdq(1,0,0) + PDQ(0,0,0)),
    NNETAR = NNETAR(log_count),
    Regression = TSLM(log_count ~ trend() + season()),
  )
# LJUNG- BOX test
lb_results <- fit_all %>%
  augment() %>%
  features(.innov, ljung_box, lag = 12) %>%
  rename(LB_pvalue = lb_pvalue)
# 6. FORECASTING
fc_all <- fit_all %>% forecast(h = h_horizon)

# 7. MODEL COMPARISON
accuracy_table <- fc_all %>%
  accuracy(airbnb_short) %>%
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE, MASE) %>%
  left_join(lb_results, by = ".model") %>%
  arrange(RMSE)

kable(
  accuracy_table,
  caption = "Table 1: Forecast Model Accuracy Comparison"
)

# 8. FINAL VISUALIZATION
fc_all %>%
  autoplot(airbnb_short, level = NULL) +
  labs(
    y = "Log(Count)",
    title = "Forecast vs Actuals",
    subtitle = "Fortworth Airbnb Reviews"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# FINAL MODEL
final_production_fit <- airbnb_short %>%
  model(Best_Model = TSLM(log_count ~ trend() + season()))

final_production_fit %>% gg_tsresiduals()

# 9. RESIDUAL DIAGNOSTIC TEST (Ljung-Box Test)
ljung_box_test <- final_production_fit %>%
  augment() %>%
  features(.innov, ljung_box, lag = 12)

kable(ljung_box_test, caption = "Ljung-Box Test for Residual Independence")

final_production_fit %>%
  forecast(h = 6) %>%
  autoplot(airbnb_short) +
  labs(title = "Final 6-Month Forecast", 
       subtitle = "Optimized via Regression (TSLM)", 
       y = "Log(Count)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
